announcements.headline: Result of AGM

announcements.insight: Director Dealings in June indicate insider activity. The August drill completion and November gold intercept suggest operational progress at Eagle Lake.

announcements.insight: Talon Resources Plc has completed preparation for its drill programme. This follows the recent admission to AIM and director dealings recorded in June.

announcements.headline: Readmission - Talon Resources plc
announcements.insight: Following the May schedule and June admission, this readmission confirms the successful completion of the listing process for shareholders.
